call_purpose: Some of your students said your course lesson videos keep loading and never play, mostly on their phones.

covered.text: We opened the lesson link you shared on desktop Chrome, on Safari and on a phone, and the video played each time, so we could not reproduce the problem from our side.

customer_next_steps.text: Ask one of your affected students to make a short screen recording showing the video loading, and send it to us along with the lesson link.

support_next_steps.text: We will raise this with our technical team and get back to you. We could not give a timeline during the call.
